source: Operational Capabilities Phase 5.16 - End-to-End Automation Workflow
description: Playbook for deliver-asset-end-to-end. It coordinates existing capabilities and stops when scope, governance or approval is missing.

playbooks.objective: Convert a user request into a governed, deterministic, reversible execution plan and execute only approved applicable phases.

publicCatalogRules.calculator: Use data/tools.json only when a calculator page is approved for catalog publication.
publicCatalogRules.article: Use data/articles.json only when an article page is approved for catalog publication.
publicCatalogRules.guideOrNucleus: Use data/brain/nuclei.json only when the current runtime projection requires it.
publicCatalogRules.rule: Do not copy PAM into public catalogs.

distributionRules.tools: Tools page follows data/tools.json; Home exposure requires explicit showOnHome approval.
distributionRules.blog: Blog follows data/articles.json; category exposure requires approved projection.
distributionRules.guide: Guide page generation and Home exposure require governed Guide/Nucleus projection.
distributionRules.category: Use deterministic articleFilter; do not use title keyword heuristics.
distributionRules.sitemap: Add URL only after physical page and canonical are valid.
distributionRules.indexnow: Dry-run first; send only after explicit approval.

linkAndCtaRules.calculator: Use contextual links only when approved.
linkAndCtaRules.pillarArticle: CTA to calculator and satellite links only when approved.
linkAndCtaRules.satelliteArticle: CTA to calculator at approved beginning, middle and final positions without duplicates.
linkAndCtaRules.guide: Links to calculator, pillar and satellites only when relationships are approved.

testingPolicy.rule: Do not mark a test PASS when it was not executed.

idempotencyRules: Do not duplicate asset, card, catalog entry, relationship, CTA, sitemap URL or publication report.
Return SKIPPED_ALREADY_COMPLIANT when the requested state already exists.
